title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes and version bumps
author: Nora Patel
description: This PR standardizes auth and retry behavior across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics, and applies parity fixes plus coordinated version bumps. Motivation: inconsistencies in transient auth error handling and streaming backpressure were causing observable differences in production and CI. Changes include: (1) shared retry policy semantics (exponential_backoff with jitter, idempotency-aware retry gates), (2) unify token refresh hooks so all SDKs expose on_token_refresh and surface refresh errors consistently, (3) streaming client ergonomic improvements: simpler async iterator in Python, unified event emitter API in TS, and context-aware reader in Go, (4) parity fixes for request/response metadata (client_request_id, route metadata), (5) bump SDK versions: python 1.4.0, typescript 2.3.0, go 0.9.5, and update changelogs. This PR includes tests and a coordination script to publish parity fixtures used by the CI matrix. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and compatibility notes.
commits: Refactor: extract common retry policy interface (python/ts/go)
SDK: add on_token_refresh hook and surface refresh errors in all languages
Streaming: ergonomic API changes and backwards-compatible adapters
Fix: include client_request_id in metadata for all SDKs
chore: bump versions and update changelogs
review_comments: Ethan Brooks: Left a few nits around docstrings in python async iterator; please ensure backwards-compatible adapter is documented.
Priya Singh: Can we make the default retry policy slightly more conservative for streaming requests? Suggested lowering max_retries for non-idempotent endpoints.
Carlos Martinez: Found a race in Go token refresh under heavy parallelism; added a suggested mutex patch.
Nora Patel (author): addressed comments; added adapter layer to preserve old streaming API surface and updated changelog with migration steps.
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth token refresh and retry semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go
Streaming: improved ergonomics with backwards-compatible adapters; see upgrade guide
Fixes: consistent client_request_id metadata across SDKs
